chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a person in the state of ihram getting married. He said: "No, and the muhrim does not marry off the non-muhrim."

key_terms.الْمُحِلَّ: the one who is not in the state of ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.لَا: a clear negation indicating prohibition here
key_terms.يَتَزَوَّجُ: contracts a marriage or gets married
key_terms.يُزَوِّجُ: conducts or effects a marriage for another

ai.seo_question: Can a person in the state of ihram get married or conduct a marriage contract?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marriage during ihram. It states that a muhrim may not contract a marriage for himself, nor may he conduct the marriage of someone who is not in ihram.
